children: F2Pool co-founder Wang Chun bought 18,177 ETH in two purchases during recent market declines, paying an average of $1,849 per coin for a total of $33.61 million.

According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ember tracked the purchases to Wang’s wallet (0xF42...2b51). A few days ago, when ETH fell below $2,000, he bought 10,992 ETH for $21.87 million; today, when ETH dropped to $1,600, he bought another 7,185 ETH for $11.74 million.

title: F2Pool Co-Founder Wang Chun Buys 18,177 ETH for $33.61 Million
